name: mobile-iphone17-layout
description: Focused iPhone 17 landscape geometry gate for the active HUD and every player-facing window after PhoneLandscapeV3 remediation.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='QC iPhone 17 874x402' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=874,Height=402,PixelDensity=460,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Phone} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetOrientationAsync(Enum.ScreenOrientation.LandscapeLeft) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.3) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local h=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD task.wait(.2) local p=h.ActionPunch local j=h.ActionJump local joy=h.MovementJoystick local q=h.QuestsButton local settings=h.SettingsTool local sound=h.SoundTool local more=h.MoreTool local equalActions=math.abs(p.AbsoluteSize.X-j.AbsoluteSize.X)<=1 and math.abs(p.AbsoluteSize.Y-j.AbsoluteSize.Y)<=1 local order=p.AbsolutePosition.X<j.AbsolutePosition.X and settings.AbsolutePosition.X>sound.AbsolutePosition.X and sound.AbsolutePosition.X>more.AbsolutePosition.X local result={profile=g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveProfile'),width=g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveViewportWidth'),height=g:GetAttribute('ResponsiveViewportHeight'),contract=h:GetAttribute('PhoneLayoutContractVersion'),targets=h:GetAttribute('PhonePrimaryTargetsPass'),targetFailures=h:GetAttribute('PhonePrimaryTargetFailures'),bounds=h:GetAttribute('PhonePrimaryBoundsPass'),pairwise=h:GetAttribute('PhonePrimaryPairwisePass'),overlapPair=h:GetAttribute('PhonePrimaryOverlapPair'),coverage=h:GetAttribute('PhoneControlCoveragePass'),punchMax=h:GetAttribute('PhonePunchMaximumPass'),joystickMax=h:GetAttribute('PhoneJoystickMaximumPass'),questHidden=not q.Visible,punch=math.max(p.AbsoluteSize.X,p.AbsoluteSize.Y),jump=math.max(j.AbsoluteSize.X,j.AbsoluteSize.Y),equalActions=equalActions,order=order,actionOrder=h:GetAttribute('PhoneActionOrder'),joystick=math.max(joy.AbsoluteSize.X,joy.AbsoluteSize.Y)} assert(result.profile=='PhoneLandscape' and result.width==874 and result.height>=360 and result.height<=402 and result.contract=='PhoneLandscapeV5' and result.targets and result.bounds and result.pairwise and result.coverage and result.punchMax and result.joystickMax and result.questHidden and result.punch<=86 and result.equalActions and result.order and result.actionOrder=='PunchThenJump' and result.joystick<=102,'iPhone HUD contract '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: iPhone HUD is bounded sparse and touch safe

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local h=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD local names={'PowerCard','CoinsCard','WallCard','HonorCurrencyHUD','TutorialObjectiveHUD','NextWorldCard'} local function overlap(a,b) local ap,as,bp,bs=a.AbsolutePosition,a.AbsoluteSize,b.AbsolutePosition,b.AbsoluteSize return math.max(0,math.min(ap.X+as.X,bp.X+bs.X)-math.max(ap.X,bp.X))*math.max(0,math.min(ap.Y+as.Y,bp.Y+bs.Y)-math.max(ap.Y,bp.Y)) end local objects={} for _,n in ipairs(names) do objects[n]=h:FindFirstChild(n,true) assert(objects[n],n..' missing') end local stats={objects.PowerCard,objects.CoinsCard,objects.WallCard,objects.HonorCurrencyHUD} local rowAligned=true local rowClear=true local centerY=stats[1].AbsolutePosition.Y+stats[1].AbsoluteSize.Y*.5 for i,item in ipairs(stats) do rowAligned=rowAligned and math.abs(item.AbsolutePosition.Y+item.AbsoluteSize.Y*.5-centerY)<=1 if i<#stats then rowClear=rowClear and overlap(item,stats[i+1])<1 end rowClear=rowClear and overlap(item,objects.TutorialObjectiveHUD)<1 end local objectiveCompact=objects.TutorialObjectiveHUD.AbsoluteSize.X<=220 and objects.TutorialObjectiveHUD.AbsoluteSize.Y<=30 and objects.TutorialObjectiveHUD.AbsolutePosition.Y>=stats[1].AbsolutePosition.Y+stats[1].AbsoluteSize.Y local textFit=true for _,n in ipairs({'PowerValue','CoinsValue','DepthValue','ObjectiveText','HonorValue'}) do local x=h:FindFirstChild(n,true) textFit=textFit and x~=nil and x.TextFits end local result={topClear=rowClear,rowAligned=rowAligned,objectiveCompact=objectiveCompact,textFit=textFit,downtownHidden=not objects.NextWorldCard.Visible,downtownReason=objects.NextWorldCard:GetAttribute('DisabledReason'),rankHidden=not h.DepthRankHUD.Visible,questCardHidden=not h.QuestCard.Visible,info=h:GetAttribute('PhoneLandscapeInformationProfile')} assert(result.topClear and result.rowAligned and result.objectiveCompact and result.textFit and result.downtownHidden and result.downtownReason=='DowntownNotReleased' and result.rankHidden and result.questCardHidden and result.info=='FourStatsAlignedNoDowntownV5','information hierarchy '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation assert(a:Invoke('ShowToast',{message='CELESTIAL GUARDIAN EQUIPPED',icon='Pet'})) task.wait(.2) local holder=g:FindFirstChild('Toasts') local toast for _,x in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do if x:IsA('TextLabel') then toast=x end end local result={visible=holder.Visible and toast~=nil,profile=toast and toast:GetAttribute('ToastResponsiveProfile'),width=toast and toast.AbsoluteSize.X or 0,height=toast and toast.AbsoluteSize.Y or 0,textSize=toast and toast.TextSize or 999,textFits=toast and toast.TextFits or false,text=toast and toast.Text or ''} assert(result.visible and result.profile=='PhoneCompactNoticeV1' and result.width<=232 and result.height<=34 and result.textSize<=10 and result.textFits,'premium pet notice '..H:JSONEncode(result)) a:Invoke('ClearToasts') return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: premium pet equipped notice stays compact

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('OpenInventory','All') task.wait(.4) local root=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory local cardHeight=root:GetAttribute('InventoryCardHeight') or 999 local result={visible=root.Visible,drawer=root:GetAttribute('InventoryDetailMode')=='Drawer',bounded=root:GetAttribute('InventoryBoundsPass')~=false,modal=g.GameMenu:GetAttribute('InventoryModalSizing'),layout=root:GetAttribute('InventoryMobileLayout'),columns=root:GetAttribute('InventoryColumns'),cardHeight=cardHeight,windowHeight=root:GetAttribute('InventoryRenderedWindowHeight')} assert(result.visible and result.drawer and result.bounded and result.modal=='PhoneSafeMargin12V3' and result.layout=='PhoneDenseBalancedV5' and result.columns>=5 and result.cardHeight<=94 and result.windowHeight<=354,'Inventory All '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: Inventory All uses bounded phone drawer

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation local root=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory local states={} for _,category in ipairs({'Pets','Honor'}) do a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory',category) task.wait(.3) local s=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') local l=s.layout or {} local duplicates=0 for _,card in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if card:IsA('GuiButton') and card.Name:find('ItemCard_',1,true)==1 and (card:GetAttribute('InventoryLockedLabelCount') or 0)>1 then duplicates+=1 end end states[category]={category=s.category,compact=l.compact,detailMode=l.detailMode,visibleCount=#(s.visibleKeys or {}),duplicates=duplicates} end assert(states.Pets.category=='Pets' and states.Pets.compact and states.Pets.detailMode=='Drawer' and states.Pets.duplicates==0 and states.Honor.category=='Honor' and states.Honor.compact and states.Honor.detailMode=='Drawer' and states.Honor.duplicates==0,'Inventory categories '..H:JSONEncode(states)) return H:JSONEncode(states)

steps.label: Inventory Pets and Honor retain compact detail behavior

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation local pages={} assert(a:Invoke('OpenTab','Fists')==true,'Shop host did not open') for _,page in ipairs({'Fists','Premium','Boosts','Honor','Robux'}) do a:Invoke('OpenShopPage',page) task.wait(.35) local s=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop local small,notFit,cards,maxCard=0,0,0,0 local function shown(x) local n=x while n and n~=s.Parent do if n:IsA('GuiObject') and not n.Visible then return false end if n==s then break end n=n.Parent end return true end for _,x in ipairs(s:GetDescendants()) do if shown(x) and x:IsA('GuiButton') and math.min(x.AbsoluteSize.X,x.AbsoluteSize.Y)<44 then small+=1 end if shown(x) and (x:IsA('TextLabel') or x:IsA('TextButton')) and x.Text~='' and not x.TextFits then notFit+=1 end if x:IsA('Frame') and x.Name:sub(-8)=='ShopCard' then cards+=1 maxCard=math.max(maxCard,x.AbsoluteSize.Y) end end pages[page]={visible=s.Visible,small=small,notFit=notFit,cards=cards,maxCard=maxCard,layout=s:GetAttribute('ShopCompactLayout'),scroll=s:GetAttribute('ShopCatalogScrollMode')} assert(s.Visible and small==0 and notFit==0 and s:GetAttribute('ShopCompactLayout')=='MobileCatalogDenseV3' and s:GetAttribute('ShopCompactCardHeight')==86 and maxCard<=87 and (page~='Boosts' or cards==2),page..' shop '..H:JSONEncode(pages[page])) end return H:JSONEncode(pages)

steps.label: all five Shop pages fit iPhone 17

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('CloseMenus') a:Invoke('OpenMore') task.wait(.3) local w=g.GameMenu local s=a:Invoke('Snapshot') return H:JSONEncode({visible=w.Visible,active=s.activeTab,margin=w:GetAttribute('CompactModalSafeMargin'),legacyTabs=w.Tabs.Visible})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('CloseMenus') a:Invoke('OpenRebirth','iphone17_flow') task.wait(.3) local w=g.RebirthWindow local review=w:FindFirstChild('ReviewRebirth',true) or w:FindFirstChild('RebirthLocked',true) local result={visible=w.Visible,profile=w:GetAttribute('ResponsiveProfile'),header=w:GetAttribute('CompactHeaderSafeLeft'),control=review and math.min(review.AbsoluteSize.X,review.AbsoluteSize.Y) or 0} assert(result.visible and result.profile=='StandaloneCompactSafeV1' and result.header>=90 and result.control>=44,'Rebirth '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: Rebirth compact header and action fit

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('CloseMenus') a:Invoke('OpenSettings','iphone17_flow') task.wait(.3) local w=g.SettingsWindow local result={visible=w.Visible,profile=w:GetAttribute('ResponsiveProfile'),contained=w:GetAttribute('CompactSettingsRowsContained'),rows=w:GetAttribute('CompactSettingsRowCount')} assert(result.visible and result.profile=='StandaloneCompactSafeV1' and result.contained and result.rows==3,'Settings '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation a:Invoke('CloseMenus') a:Invoke('OpenSpin') task.wait(.3) local w=g.HeroSpinModal local panel=w.SpinPanel local close=panel.CloseSpin local buy=panel.BuyBonusSpins local result={visible=w.Visible,hudHidden=not g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD.Visible,compact=g:GetAttribute('SpinLayoutCompact'),margin=g:GetAttribute('SpinSafeEdgeMargin'),close=math.min(close.AbsoluteSize.X,close.AbsoluteSize.Y),buy=math.min(buy.AbsoluteSize.X,buy.AbsoluteSize.Y)} assert(result.visible and result.hudHidden and result.compact and result.margin==32 and result.close>=44 and result.buy>=44,'Spin '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: Hero Spin is isolated and touch safe

args.code: local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) local removed=0 for _,id in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id) if info.Name=='QC iPhone 17 874x402' and info.IsCustom then S:RemoveDeviceAsync(id) removed+=1 end end return {default=S:GetDeviceAsync()=='default',removed=removed}
local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') pcall(function() S:StopSimulationAsync() end) return true
